moco_c2_cifar10_best.feature_cosine_note: These are deterministic downstream diagnostics, not the training-stage validation alignment_similarity.

protocol.normalization_order: downstream image -> resize to 32x32 if needed -> optional trigger -> CIFAR10 encoder normalization
protocol.classifier_selection: best fixed-split downstream validation accuracy per repetition
protocol.pair_order_invariant_seed_rule: pair classifier seeds depend on global seed, repetition index and repeat seed; pair name and command position are excluded
protocol.pair_classifier_fairness: all pairs share initial weights, DataLoader order and dropout RNG within each repetition when architecture dimensions match
